Picture: the geometry of similar matrices.
Vocabulary word: similarity.
Some matrices are easy to understand.

For instance, a diagonal matrix
      <me>
        D = \mat{2 0 ; 0 1/2}
      </me>
      just scales the coordinates of a vector: <m>D{x\choose y} = {2x\choose y/2}</m>.
The purpose of most of the rest of this chapter is to understand complicated-looking matrices by analyzing to what extent they <q>behave like</q> simple matrices.
segments.translation: 이 장의 나머지 대부분은 복잡해 보이는 행렬이 단순한 행렬과 어느 정도까지 <q>비슷하게 작용하는지</q> 분석함으로써 그 행렬을 이해하는 것을 목적으로 합니다.

segments.source:
For instance, the matrix
      <me>
        A = \frac 1{10}\mat{11 6; 9 14}
      </me>
      has eigenvalues <m>2</m> and <m>1/2</m>, with corresponding eigenvectors <m>v_1 = {2/3\choose 1}</m> and <m>v_2 = {-1\choose 1}</m>.
The matrices <m>A</m> and <m>D</m> behave similarly.
Click <q>multiply</q> to multiply the colored points by <m>D</m> on the left and <m>A</m> on the right.  (We will see in <xref ref="diagonalization"/> why the points follow hyperbolic paths.)
segments.translation: <q>multiply</q>를 클릭하면 색칠된 점들에 왼쪽에서는 <m>D</m>를, 오른쪽에서는 <m>A</m>를 곱합니다. (점들이 왜 쌍곡선 경로를 따라가는지는 <xref ref="diagonalization"/>에서 살펴보겠습니다.)

segments.source: The other case of particular importance will be matrices that <q>behave</q> like a rotation matrix: indeed, this will be crucial for understanding <xref ref="complex-eigenvalues"/> geometrically.
segments.translation: 또 하나 특히 중요한 경우는 회전 행렬처럼 <q>작용하는</q> 행렬입니다. 실제로 이는 <xref ref="complex-eigenvalues"/>를 기하학적으로 이해하는 데 결정적인 역할을 합니다.

segments.source: See this <xref ref="similarity-to-rotation"/>.
In this section, we study in detail the situation when two matrices behave similarly with respect to different coordinate systems.
segments.translation: 이 절에서는 두 행렬이 서로 다른 좌표계에 대해 비슷하게 작용하는 상황을 자세히 살펴봅니다.

segments.source: In <xref ref="diagonalization"/> and <xref ref="complex-eigenvalues"/>, we will show how to use eigenvalues and eigenvectors to find a simpler matrix that behaves like a given matrix.
segments.translation: <xref ref="diagonalization"/>와 <xref ref="complex-eigenvalues"/>에서는 고윳값과 고유벡터를 사용하여 주어진 행렬과 비슷하게 작용하는 더 단순한 행렬을 찾는 방법을 보이겠습니다.

segments.source: Similar Matrices
We begin with the algebraic definition of similarity.
Two <m>n\times n</m> matrices <m>A</m> and <m>B</m> are <term>similar</term> if there exists an invertible <m>n\times n</m> matrix <m>C</m> such that <m>A = CBC\inv</m>.
segments.translation: 두 <m>n\times n</m> 행렬 <m>A</m>와 <m>B</m>에 대해 <m>A = CBC\inv</m>를 만족하는 가역 <m>n\times n</m> 행렬 <m>C</m>가 존재하면, <m>A</m>와 <m>B</m>는 <term>닮았다</term>고 합니다.

segments.source:
The matrices
        <me>
          \mat{-12 15; -10 13} \sptxt{and} \mat{3 0; 0 -2}
        </me>
        are similar because
        <me>
          \mat{-12 15; -10 13} = \mat{-2 3; 1 -1} \mat{3 0; 0 -2} \mat{-2 3; 1 -1}\inv,
        </me>
        as the reader can verify.
segments.translation:
행렬 <me>
          \mat{-12 15; -10 13} \sptxt{and} \mat{3 0; 0 -2}
        </me>는 닮았습니다. 독자가 확인할 수 있듯이 <me>
          \mat{-12 15; -10 13} = \mat{-2 3; 1 -1} \mat{3 0; 0 -2} \mat{-2 3; 1 -1}\inv,
        </me>이기 때문입니다.

segments.source:
The matrices
        <me>
          \mat{3 0 ; 0 -2} \sptxt{and} \mat{1 0; 0 1}
        </me>
        are not similar.

Indeed, the second matrix is the identity matrix <m>I_2</m>, so if <m>C</m> is any invertible <m>2\times 2</m> matrix, then
        <me>
          CI_2C\inv = CC\inv = I_2 \neq \mat{3 0; 0 -2}.
        </me>
segments.translation:
실제로 두 번째 행렬은 단위행렬 <m>I_2</m>이므로, <m>C</m>가 임의의 가역 <m>2\times 2</m> 행렬이면 <me>
          CI_2C\inv = CC\inv = I_2 \neq \mat{3 0; 0 -2}.
        </me>

segments.source:
<idx><h>Similarity</h><h>identity matrix</h></idx>
      <idx><h>Identity matrix</h><h>similarity</h></idx>
      As in the above example, one can show that <m>I_n</m> is the only matrix that is similar to <m>I_n</m>, and likewise for any scalar multiple of <m>I_n</m>.
segments.translation: <idx><h>Similarity</h><h>identity matrix</h></idx> <idx><h>Identity matrix</h><h>similarity</h></idx> 위의 예에서와 마찬가지로, 단위행렬 <m>I_n</m>과 닮은 행렬은 <m>I_n</m>뿐임을 보일 수 있으며, <m>I_n</m>의 임의의 스칼라배에 대해서도 마찬가지입니다.

segments.source: Similarity is unrelated to row equivalence.
Any invertible matrix is row equivalent to <m>I_n</m>, but <m>I_n</m> is the only matrix similar to <m>I_n</m>.
segments.translation: 모든 가역 행렬은 <m>I_n</m>과 행 동치이지만, <m>I_n</m>과 닮은 행렬은 <m>I_n</m>뿐입니다.

segments.source:
For instance,
        <me>\mat{2 1; 0 2} \sptxt{and} \mat{1 0; 0 1}</me>
        are row equivalent but not similar.
segments.translation: 예를 들어, <me>\mat{2 1; 0 2} \sptxt{and} \mat{1 0; 0 1}</me>는 행 동치이지만 닮지 않았습니다.

segments.source: As suggested by its name, similarity is what is called an equivalence relation.
segments.translation: 이름에서 짐작할 수 있듯이, 닮음은 이른바 동치 관계입니다.

segments.source: This means that it satisfies the following properties.
segments.translation: 이는 닮음이 다음 성질들을 만족한다는 뜻입니다.

segments.source: Let <m>A,B</m>, and <m>C</m> be <m>n\times n</m> matrices.
<alert>Reflexivity:</alert> <m>A</m> is similar to itself.
<alert>Symmetry:</alert> if <m>A</m> is similar to <m>B</m>, then <m>B</m> is similar to <m>A</m>.
<alert>Transitivity:</alert> if <m>A</m> is similar to <m>B</m> and <m>B</m> is similar to <m>C</m>, then <m>A</m> is similar to <m>C</m>.
Taking <m>C = I_n = I_n\inv</m>, we have <m>A = I_n A I_n\inv</m>.
segments.translation: <m>C = I_n = I_n\inv</m>로 잡으면 <m>A = I_n A I_n\inv</m>를 얻습니다.

segments.source: Suppose that <m>A = CBC\inv.</m>

Multiplying both sides on the left by <m>C\inv</m> and on the right by <m>C</m> gives
              <me>
                C\inv A C = C\inv(CBC\inv)C = B.
              </me>
segments.translation:
양변의 왼쪽에 <m>C\inv</m>를, 오른쪽에 <m>C</m>를 곱하면 다음을 얻습니다. <me>
                C\inv A C = C\inv(CBC\inv)C = B.
              </me>

segments.source: Since <m>(C\inv)\inv = C</m>, we have <m>B = C\inv A (C\inv)\inv</m>, so that <m>B</m> is similar to <m>A</m>.
Suppose that <m>A = DBD\inv</m> and <m>B = ECE\inv</m>.

Subsituting for <m>B</m> and remembering that <m>(DE)\inv = E\inv D\inv</m>, we have
              <me>
                A = D(ECE\inv)D\inv = (DE)C(DE)\inv,
              </me>
              which shows that <m>A</m> is similar to <m>C</m>.
segments.translation:
<m>B</m>를 대입하고 <m>(DE)\inv = E\inv D\inv</m>임을 기억하면 다음을 얻습니다. <me>
                A = D(ECE\inv)D\inv = (DE)C(DE)\inv,
              </me> 이는 <m>A</m>가 <m>C</m>와 닮음임을 보여 줍니다.

segments.source:
The matrices
        <me>\mat{-12 15; -10 13} \sptxt{and} \mat{3 0; 0 -2}</me>
        are similar, as we saw in this <xref ref="similarity-eg1"/>.

Likewise, the matrices
        <me>\mat{-12 15; -10 13} \sptxt{and} \mat{-12 5; -30 13}</me>
        are similar because
        <me>
          \mat{-12 5; -30 13} = \mat{2 -1; 2 1}\mat{-12 15; -10 13}\mat{2 -1; 2 1}\inv.
        </me>
segments.translation:
마찬가지로 행렬 <me>\mat{-12 15; -10 13} \sptxt{and} \mat{-12 5; -30 13}</me>도 닮음인데, 그 이유는 다음과 같습니다. <me>
          \mat{-12 5; -30 13} = \mat{2 -1; 2 1}\mat{-12 15; -10 13}\mat{2 -1; 2 1}\inv.
        </me>

segments.source:
It follows that
        <me>\mat{-12 5; -30 13} \sptxt{and} \mat{3 0; 0 -2}</me>
        are similar to each other.
We conclude with an observation about similarity and powers of matrices.
segments.translation: 닮음과 행렬의 거듭제곱에 관한 관찰로 마무리하겠습니다.

segments.source: Let <m>A = CBC\inv</m>.

Then for any <m>n\geq 1</m>, we have
          <me>A^n = CB^n C\inv.</me>
segments.translation: 그러면 임의의 <m>n\geq 1</m>에 대해 다음이 성립합니다. <me>A^n = CB^n C\inv.</me>

segments.source:
First note that
          <me>
            A^2 = AA = (CBC\inv)(CBC\inv) = CB(C\inv C)BC\inv = CBI_nBC\inv = CB^2C\inv.
          </me>
segments.translation:
먼저 다음에 주목하십시오. <me>
            A^2 = AA = (CBC\inv)(CBC\inv) = CB(C\inv C)BC\inv = CBI_nBC\inv = CB^2C\inv.
          </me>

segments.source:
Next we have
          <me>
            A^3 = A^2A = (CB^2C\inv)(CBC\inv) = CB^2(C\inv C)BC\inv = CB^3C\inv.
          </me>
segments.translation:
다음으로 아래를 얻습니다. <me>
            A^3 = A^2A = (CB^2C\inv)(CBC\inv) = CB^2(C\inv C)BC\inv = CB^3C\inv.
          </me>

segments.source: The pattern is clear.

By the <xref ref="similarity-powers"/>, we have
          <me>
            A^{100} = \mat{-2 3; 1 -1}\mat{0 -1; 1 0}^{100}\mat{-2 3; 1 -1}\inv.
          </me>
The matrix <m>\smallmat 0{-1}10</m> is a counterclockwise rotation by <m>90^\circ</m>.
If we rotate by <m>90^\circ</m> four times, then we end up where we started.
segments.translation: <m>90^\circ</m>만큼 네 번 회전하면 처음 위치로 돌아옵니다.

segments.source:
Hence rotating by <m>90^\circ</m> one hundred times is the identity transformation, so
          <me>
            A^{100} = \mat{-2 3; 1 -1}\mat{1 0; 0 1}\mat{-2 3; 1 -1}\inv
            = \mat{1 0; 0 1}.
          </me>
segments.translation:
따라서 <m>90^\circ</m>만큼 백 번 회전하는 것은 항등변환이므로 <me>
            A^{100} = \mat{-2 3; 1 -1}\mat{1 0; 0 1}\mat{-2 3; 1 -1}\inv
            = \mat{1 0; 0 1}.
          </me>

segments.source: Geometry of Similar Matrices
Similarity is a very interesting construction when viewed geometrically.
segments.translation: 닮음은 기하학적으로 볼 때 매우 흥미로운 구성입니다.

segments.source: We will see that, roughly, similar matrices do the same thing in different coordinate systems.
segments.translation: 대략적으로 말해 닮은 행렬은 서로 다른 좌표계에서 같은 일을 한다는 것을 보게 될 것입니다.

segments.source: The reader might want to review <m>\cB</m>-coordinates and nonstandard coordinate grids in <xref ref="bases-as-coord-systems"/> before reading this subsection.
segments.translation: 이 소절을 읽기 전에 <xref ref="bases-as-coord-systems"/>에서 <m>\cB</m>-좌표와 비표준 좌표 격자를 복습하는 것이 좋습니다.

segments.source: By conditions 4 and 5 of the <xref ref="imt-2"/>, an <m>n\times n</m> matrix <m>C</m> is invertible if and only if its columns <m>v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_n</m> form a basis for <m>\R^n</m>.
segments.translation: <xref ref="imt-2"/>의 조건 4와 5에 의해, <m>n\times n</m> 행렬 <m>C</m>는 그 열 <m>v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_n</m>이 <m>\R^n</m>의 기저를 이룰 때, 그리고 그때에만 가역입니다.

segments.source: This means we can speak of the <m>\cB</m>-coordinates of a vector in <m>\R^n</m>, where <m>\cB</m> is the basis of columns of <m>C</m>.
segments.translation: 이는 <m>\R^n</m>에 속한 벡터의 <m>\cB</m>-좌표를 말할 수 있다는 뜻이며, 여기서 <m>\cB</m>는 <m>C</m>의 열들로 이루어진 기저입니다.

segments.source:
Recall that
      <me>
        [x]_\cB = \vec{c_1 c_2 \vdots, c_n} \sptxt{means}
        x = c_1v_1 + c_2v_2 + \cdots + c_nv_n
        = \mat{| | ,, |; v_1 v_2 \cdots, v_n; | | ,, |}\vec{c_1 c_2 \vdots, c_n}.
      </me>
segments.translation:
다음을 상기하십시오. <me>
        [x]_\cB = \vec{c_1 c_2 \vdots, c_n} \sptxt{means}
        x = c_1v_1 + c_2v_2 + \cdots + c_nv_n
        = \mat{| | ,, |; v_1 v_2 \cdots, v_n; | | ,, |}\vec{c_1 c_2 \vdots, c_n}.
      </me>

segments.source: Since <m>C</m> is the matrix with columns <m>v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_n</m>, this says that <m>x = C[x]_\cB</m>.
segments.translation: <m>C</m>는 열이 <m>v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_n</m>인 행렬이므로, 이는 <m>x = C[x]_\cB</m>임을 말해 줍니다.

segments.source: Multiplying both sides by <m>C\inv</m> gives <m>[x]_\cB = C\inv x.</m>
To summarize:
Let <m>C</m> be an invertible <m>n\times n</m> matrix with columns <m>v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_n</m>, and let <m>\cB = \{v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_n\}</m>, a basis for <m>\R^n</m>.
segments.translation: <m>C</m>를 열이 <m>v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_n</m>인 가역 <m>n\times n</m> 행렬이라 하고, <m>\cB = \{v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_n\}</m>를 <m>\R^n</m>의 기저라 합시다.

segments.source:
Then for any <m>x</m> in <m>\R^n</m>, we have
        <me>
          C[x]_\cB = x \sptxt{and} C\inv x = [x]_\cB.
        </me>
segments.translation:
그러면 <m>\R^n</m>의 임의의 <m>x</m>에 대하여 다음이 성립합니다. <me>
          C[x]_\cB = x \sptxt{and} C\inv x = [x]_\cB.
        </me>

segments.source: This says that C changes from the \cB-coordinates to the usual coordinates, and C\inv changes from the usual coordinates to the \cB-coordinates.
segments.translation: 이는 C가 \cB-좌표를 통상적인 좌표로 바꾸고, C\inv가 통상적인 좌표를 \cB-좌표로 바꾼다는 것을 의미합니다.

segments.source: Suppose that <m>A = CBC\inv.</m>
The above observation gives us another way of computing <m>Ax</m> for a vector <m>x</m> in <m>\R^n</m>.
segments.translation: 위의 관찰은 <m>\R^n</m>의 벡터 <m>x</m>에 대하여 <m>Ax</m>를 계산하는 또 다른 방법을 제공합니다.

segments.source: Recall that CBC\inv x = C(B(C\inv x)), so that multiplying CBC\inv by x means first multiplying by C\inv, then by B, then by C.
segments.translation: CBC\inv x = C(B(C\inv x)),임을 상기하십시오. 따라서 CBC\inv에 x를 곱한다는 것은 먼저 C\inv를 곱하고, 그다음 B를 곱하고, 그다음 C를 곱한다는 의미입니다.

segments.source: See this <xref ref="matrix-mult-order-ops"/>.
Recipe: Computing <m>Ax</m> in terms of <m>B</m>
Suppose that <m>A = CBC\inv,</m> where <m>C</m> is an invertible matrix with columns <m>v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_n.</m>
segments.translation: <m>A = CBC\inv,</m>라고 가정합시다. 여기서 <m>C</m>는 열이 <m>v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_n.</m>인 가역 행렬입니다.

segments.source: Let <m>\cB = \{v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_n\}</m>, a basis for <m>\R^n</m>.
Let <m>x</m> be a vector in <m>\R^n</m>.
To compute <m>Ax</m>, one does the following:
Multiply <m>x</m> by <m>C\inv</m>, which changes to the <m>\cB</m>-coordinates: <m>[x]_\cB = C\inv x</m>.
Multiply this by <m>B</m>: <m>B[x]_\cB = BC\inv x</m>.

Interpreting this vector as a <m>\cB</m>-coordinate vector, we multiply it by <m>C</m> to change back to the usual coordinates:
            <m>Ax = CBC\inv x = CB[x]_\cB.</m>
segments.translation: 이 벡터를 <m>\cB</m>-좌표 벡터로 해석하여, 여기에 <m>C</m>를 곱해 통상적인 좌표로 되돌립니다: <m>Ax = CBC\inv x = CB[x]_\cB.</m>

segments.source: To summarize: if <m>A = CBC\inv</m>, then <m>A</m> and <m>B</m> do the same thing, only in different coordinate systems.
segments.translation: 요약하면, <m>A = CBC\inv</m>이면 <m>A</m>와 <m>B</m>는 단지 서로 다른 좌표계에서 같은 일을 합니다.

segments.source: The following example is the heart of this section.

Consider the matrices
        <me>
          A = \mat{1/2 3/2; 3/2 1/2} \qquad
          B = \mat{2 0; 0 -1} \qquad
          C = \mat{1 1; 1 -1}.
        </me>
segments.translation:
다음 행렬들을 생각해 봅시다. <me>
          A = \mat{1/2 3/2; 3/2 1/2} \qquad
          B = \mat{2 0; 0 -1} \qquad
          C = \mat{1 1; 1 -1}.
        </me>

segments.source: One can verify that <m>A = CBC\inv</m>: see this <xref ref="diagonal-eg-22"/>.
segments.translation: <m>A = CBC\inv</m>임을 확인할 수 있습니다. 이 <xref ref="diagonal-eg-22"/>을 참고하십시오.

segments.source: Let <m>v_1 = {1\choose 1}</m> and <m>v_2 = {1\choose -1}</m>, the columns of <m>C</m>, and let <m>\cB = \{v_1,v_2\}</m>, a basis of <m>\R^2</m>.
The matrix <m>B</m> is diagonal: it scales the <m>x</m>-direction by a factor of <m>2</m> and the <m>y</m>-direction by a factor of <m>-1</m>.
segments.translation: 행렬 <m>B</m>는 대각 행렬입니다. 이 행렬은 <m>x</m>-방향을 <m>2</m>배로, <m>y</m>-방향을 <m>-1</m>배로 늘이거나 줄입니다.

Eigenvalues of Similar Matrices
Since similar matrices behave in the same way with respect to different coordinate systems, we should expect their eigenvalues and eigenvectors to be closely related.
segments.translation: 닮은 행렬은 서로 다른 좌표계에 대해 같은 방식으로 작용하므로, 그 고윳값과 고유벡터도 밀접하게 관련되어 있으리라 예상할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Fact
Similar matrices have the same characteristic polynomial.
Suppose that <m>A = CBC\inv</m>, where <m>A,B,C</m> are <m>n\times n</m> matrices.

We calculate
          <me>
            \begin{split}
            A - \lambda I_n
            \amp= CBC\inv - \lambda CC\inv
            = CBC\inv - C\lambda C\inv \\
            \amp= CBC\inv - C\lambda I_n C\inv
            = C(B-\lambda I_n)C\inv.
            \end{split}
          </me>
          Therefore,
          <me>
            \det(A-\lambda I_n) = \det(C(B-\lambda I_n)C\inv)
            = \det(C)\det(B-\lambda I_n)\det(C)\inv
            = \det(B-\lambda I_n).
          </me>
segments.translation:
다음과 같이 계산합니다. <me>
            \begin{split}
            A - \lambda I_n
            \amp= CBC\inv - \lambda CC\inv
            = CBC\inv - C\lambda C\inv \\
            \amp= CBC\inv - C\lambda I_n C\inv
            = C(B-\lambda I_n)C\inv.
            \end{split}
          </me> 따라서 <me>
            \det(A-\lambda I_n) = \det(C(B-\lambda I_n)C\inv)
            = \det(C)\det(B-\lambda I_n)\det(C)\inv
            = \det(B-\lambda I_n).
          </me>

segments.source: Here we have used the <xref ref="det-defn-mult-prop">multiplicativity property</xref> and its <xref ref="det-defn-power-prop">corollary</xref>.
Since the eigenvalues of a matrix are the roots of its characteristic polynomial, we have shown:

Indeed, the matrices
        <me>\mat{1 1; 0 1} \sptxt{and} \mat{1 0 ; 0 1}</me>
        both have characteristic polynomial <m>f(\lambda) = (\lambda-1)^2</m>, but they are not similar, because the only matrix that is similar to <m>I_2</m> is <m>I_2</m> itself.
segments.translation: 실제로 행렬 <me>\mat{1 1; 0 1} \sptxt{and} \mat{1 0 ; 0 1}</me>는 둘 다 특성다항식 <m>f(\lambda) = (\lambda-1)^2</m>를 가지지만, <m>I_2</m>와 닮은 유일한 행렬은 <m>I_2</m> 자신뿐이므로 두 행렬은 닮지 않았습니다.

segments.source: Given that similar matrices have the same eigenvalues, one might guess that they have the same eigenvectors as well.
segments.translation: 닮은 행렬이 같은 고윳값을 가진다는 점을 생각하면, 고유벡터도 같을 것이라고 추측할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Upon reflection, this is not what one should expect: indeed, the eigenvectors should only match up after changing from one coordinate system to another.
segments.translation: 곰곰이 생각해 보면, 이는 기대할 만한 것이 아닙니다. 실제로 고유벡터는 한 좌표계에서 다른 좌표계로 바꾼 뒤에야 서로 대응해야 합니다.

segments.source: This is the content of the next fact, remembering that <m>C</m> and <m>C\inv</m> change between the usual coordinates and the <m>\cB</m>-coordinates.
segments.translation: <m>C</m>와 <m>C\inv</m>가 일반 좌표와 <m>\cB</m>-좌표 사이를 변환한다는 점을 기억하면, 이것이 바로 다음 사실의 내용입니다.

segments.source: Fact
Suppose that <m>A = CBC\inv</m>.

Then
          <me>
            \begin{split}
            v \text{ is an eigenvector of } A
            \amp\quad\implies\quad C\inv v \text{ is an eigenvector of } B \\
            v \text{ is an eigenvector of } B
            \amp\quad\implies\quad C v \text{ is an eigenvector of } A. \\
            \end{split}
          </me>
          The eigenvalues of <m>v</m> / <m>C\inv v</m> or <m>v</m> / <m>Cv</m> are the same.
segments.translation:
그러면 <me>
            \begin{split}
            v \text{ is an eigenvector of } A
            \amp\quad\implies\quad C\inv v \text{ is an eigenvector of } B \\
            v \text{ is an eigenvector of } B
            \amp\quad\implies\quad C v \text{ is an eigenvector of } A. \\
            \end{split}
          </me> 고유벡터 <m>v</m> / <m>C\inv v</m> 또는 <m>v</m> / <m>Cv</m>의 고윳값은 같습니다.

segments.source: Suppose that <m>v</m> is an eigenvector of <m>A</m> with eigenvalue <m>\lambda</m>, so that <m>Av = \lambda v</m>.

Then
          <me>B(C\inv v) = C\inv(CBC\inv v) = C\inv(Av) = C\inv\lambda v = \lambda(C\inv v),</me>
          so that <m>C\inv v</m> is an eigenvector of <m>B</m> with eigenvalue <m>\lambda</m>.
segments.translation: 그러면 <me>B(C\inv v) = C\inv(CBC\inv v) = C\inv(Av) = C\inv\lambda v = \lambda(C\inv v),</me> 따라서 <m>C\inv v</m>는 고윳값 <m>\lambda</m>를 가지는 <m>B</m>의 고유벡터입니다.

segments.source:
Likewise if <m>v</m> is an eigenvector of <m>B</m> with eigenvalue <m>\lambda</m>, then <m>Bv = \lambda v</m>, and we have
          <me>A(Cv) = (CBC\inv)Cv = CBv = C(\lambda v) = \lambda(Cv),</me>
          so that <m>Cv</m> is an eigenvalue of <m>A</m> with eigenvalue <m>\lambda</m>.
segments.translation: 마찬가지로 <m>v</m>가 고윳값 <m>\lambda</m>를 가지는 <m>B</m>의 고유벡터이면 <m>Bv = \lambda v</m>이고, <me>A(Cv) = (CBC\inv)Cv = CBv = C(\lambda v) = \lambda(Cv),</me> 따라서 <m>Cv</m>는 고윳값 <m>\lambda</m>를 가지는 <m>A</m>의 고윳값입니다.

segments.source: If <m>A = CBC\inv</m>, then <m>C\inv</m> takes the <m>\lambda</m>-eigenspace of <m>A</m> to the <m>\lambda</m>-eigenspace of <m>B</m>, and <m>C</m> takes the <m>\lambda</m>-eigenspace of <m>B</m> to the <m>\lambda</m>-eigenspace of <m>A</m>.

We continue with the above <xref ref="similarity-worked-eg"/>: let
        <me>
          A = \mat{1/2 3/2; 3/2 1/2} \qquad
          B = \mat{2 0; 0 -1} \qquad
          C = \mat{1 1; 1 -1},
        </me>
        so <m>A = CBC\inv.</m>
segments.translation:
위의 <xref ref="similarity-worked-eg"/>를 계속 살펴봅시다. <me>
          A = \mat{1/2 3/2; 3/2 1/2} \qquad
          B = \mat{2 0; 0 -1} \qquad
          C = \mat{1 1; 1 -1},
        </me>라고 하면 <m>A = CBC\inv.</m>입니다.

segments.source: Let <m>v_1 = {1\choose 1}</m> and <m>v_2 = {1\choose -1}</m>, the columns of <m>C</m>.
Recall that:
<m>B</m> scales the <m>e_1</m>-direction by <m>2</m> and the <m>e_2</m>-direction by <m>-1</m>.
<m>A</m> scales the <m>v_1</m>-direction by <m>2</m> and the <m>v_2</m>-direction by <m>-1</m>.

Then:
